items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...But there was uh because when he used to play the colored parades and went for the funerals. That band was uh Joe Oliver, Freddy Keppler, Manuel Perez. See. Big Eye Louie on clarinet. It was a very good brass band.

ctx.x: Certainly they had good colored bands. Yeah they had some good colored bands. Manuel Perez had a good band. And uh Freddy Caput had a good band. Yeah they were lots of colored bands.

Those fellas were all right. Now you see like uh like Papa Celestine. There's nothing there. But Manuel Perez used to play good trumpet there. And uh Freddy Keppler. His name is Kepard. See. He used to play a lot of trumpet. Well uh Joe Oliver too then was you know pretty good when he was younger. Then he got to the corny later on in years. But there was uh because when he used to play the colored parades and went for the funerals. That band was uh Joe Oliver, Freddy Keppler, Manuel Perez. See. Big Eye Louie on…

A white, a white, you see in those days a colored band could play a white picnic. Always did play them. But no white band ever played a colored thing. You see this was. And therefore you'd be playing up against colored bands because one band would be here. One band maybe be about four bands right. Yeah. Playing all day. All surrounded. See. Blowing out of each other. There was no, there was no, no, no dissension, no trouble. There was nothing. You know. Blowing. Because they played the picnics but the white…
